name: translate
title: 翻译
description: Translate text, files, and conversations between any languages. Auto-detects source language. Preserves formatting (markdown, code blocks, tables). Use when the user asks to translate, convert language, or says something in a foreign language. Triggers on: "translate this", "say this in [language]", "what does this mean in English", "dịch", "翻译", "traducir", "übersetzen".
